scope: Resample Apps text tint after scrolling settles and coalesce sparse glyph snapshot requests.

checks.command: Flick a populated 285-app Launchpad grid against v0.85.39 in isolated plasmoidviewer, explicitly selecting identical line scope and backdrop on both sides. Two 120-frame runs improved from 58.7/58.1 to 62.8/62.7 FPS. Frame time p95 fell from 22.0/21.0 to 19.4/19.4 ms.

Send 121 moving glyph requests at 16 ms intervals in isolated KWin. Reply batches fell from 24 to 9 on Wayland and 25 to 9 on X11. Both delivered the final coordinates and the exact original RGB value. Build the shared compositor code for 6.6.4, 6.7.4 and 6.8.2 Wayland and 6.7.4 X11.
Exercise the native Golden Gate Light Apps popup and Tahoe Light clipboard interactions in isolated plasmoidviewer.

coverage_limits: Scroll frame measurements use software OpenGL and a fixed RGB backdrop. Sparse readback measurements exercise custom letter scope. Installed custom profiles retain their scope.
